items.title: CreatorIQ Appoints Ray Ball as Chief People Officer to Support Next Phase of Global Growth
items.summary: LOS ANGELES, November 19, 2026--CreatorIQ, the enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, today announced the appointment of Ray Ball as Chief People Officer (CPO), expanding its executive leadership team as the company continues to grow its global customer base. Ball will report to CEO Chris Harrington and lead CreatorIQ’s global people strategy, including talent acquisition, talent management and leadership development, benefits, and employee experience.

items.title: Crude Gives Back Ground Midweek as Inventories Build and Surplus Talk Grows
items.summary: Oil Market Daily News Commentary - Crude oil heads into Thursday down for the week so far. Brent futures settled at $91.95 a barrel on Wednesday, down $1.19, or 1.28%, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate fell $2.75, or 3.2%, to $83.26, its lowest since August 26, according to Reuters. Measured from Friday's settlements of $95.84 for Brent and $88.56 for WTI, Brent is down $3.89, or 4.06%, and WTI is down $5.30, or 5.98%, for the week to date, by our arithmetic. items.summary: U.S. stocks ended mixed on Wednesday, with the Nasdaq rebounding from its previous session's losses, while the S&P 500 clocked its fifth straight day of losses as investors digested NVIDIA's earnings and awaited Anthropic's initial public offering.
